name: Lärkberget AB (publ)
summary: Lärkberget AB (publ) functions as an investment firm, engaging in a variety of financial endeavors. Its operations encompass direct capital deployment into low-risk instruments, broader financial investments, acquiring stakes in privately held yet profitable companies, and serving as a vehicle for reverse acquisitions. Established in 1990 and based in Östermalm, Sweden, the company transitioned to its current name, Lärkberget AB (publ), in June 2025, having formerly operated as CombiGene AB (publ).
